beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: To a crowd of people worn down by work, by rules, by just getting through the day,

timing.text: To a crowd of people worn down by work, by rules, by just getting through the day,

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus made one of the gentlest offers ever spoken.

timing.text: Jesus made one of the gentlest offers ever spoken.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

timing.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Come to me, all of you who are worn out and carrying too much — and I will give you rest. He does not say come once you have it handled. He says come while you are still under it.

timing.text: Come to me, all of you who are worn out and carrying too much — and I will give you rest.
He does not say come once you have it handled.
He says come while you are still under it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A yoke was the wooden beam that let two oxen pull a load together, so no single animal carried it alone.

timing.text: A yoke was the wooden beam that let two oxen pull a load together, so no single animal carried it alone.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

timing.text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

timing.text: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Take my yoke on you, he said, and learn from me, because I am gentle and I am humble — and you will find rest for your soul. He is not handing you a heavier beam. He is stepping into the empty side of the one you are already pulling.

timing.text: Take my yoke on you, he said, and learn from me, because I am gentle and I am humble — and you will find rest for your soul.
He is not handing you a heavier beam.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He wasn't promising a life with nothing to carry.

timing.text: He wasn't promising a life with nothing to carry.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He was promising to get under the load with you, so it never has to be carried alone again.

timing.text: He was promising to get under the load with you, so it never has to be carried alone again.

card.text: Whatever you've been carrying by yourself — he's offering to take the other side of it. Come.
